info.name: Restful Booker API Test Suite
info.description: Stateful, isolated Restful Booker API portfolio suite. Each run creates and deletes only its own runtime booking.

exec: pm.test('Ping returns documented 201 status', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('Valid authentication returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const auth = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Authentication response contains a string token', function () { pm.expect(auth.token).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('Authentication token is non-empty', function () { pm.expect(auth.token.trim()).to.not.equal(''); });
if (auth.token) { pm.environment.set('token', auth.token); }

item.name: Invalid credentials do not issue token

exec: pm.test('Invalid authentication returns documented 200 response', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Invalid credentials return a reason and no valid token', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('reason'); pm.expect(body.token).to.be.undefined; });
pm.test('Booking index returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Booking index is an array', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('Booking index entries expose numeric bookingid values', function () { const rows = pm.response.json(); rows.slice(0, 10).forEach(function (row) { pm.expect(row.bookingid).to.be.a('number'); }); });
const suffix = Date.now().toString() + '-' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000);
pm.environment.set('runtimeFirstName', 'QA-' + suffix);
pm.environment.set('runtimeLastName', 'Run-' + suffix);
pm.environment.unset('bookingId');
const body = pm.response.json();

const detailSchema = { type: 'object', required: ['firstname','lastname','totalprice','depositpaid','bookingdates'], properties: { firstname: {type:'string'}, lastname: {type:'string'}, totalprice: {type:'number'}, depositpaid: {type:'boolean'}, bookingdates: { type:'object', required:['checkin','checkout'], properties:{ checkin:{type:'string'}, checkout:{type:'string'} } }, additionalneeds:{type:'string'} } };
const envelopeSchema = { type:'object', required:['bookingid','booking'], properties:{ bookingid:{type:'number'}, booking:detailSchema } };
pm.test('Create booking returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Create response contains dynamic numeric bookingid', function () { pm.expect(body.bookingid).to.be.a('number').and.above(0); });

pm.test('Create response matches submitted identity and price', function () { pm.expect(body.booking.firstname).to.equal(pm.environment.get('runtimeFirstName')); pm.expect(body.booking.lastname).to.equal(pm.environment.get('runtimeLastName')); pm.expect(body.booking.totalprice).to.equal(111); });

pm.test('Create response preserves dates and additional needs', function () { pm.expect(body.booking.bookingdates).to.deep.equal({checkin:'2026-09-01', checkout:'2026-09-05'}); pm.expect(body.booking.additionalneeds).to.equal('Breakfast'); });
pm.test('Create response satisfies envelope schema', function () { pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema(envelopeSchema); });
if (body.bookingid) { pm.environment.set('bookingId', String(body.bookingid)); }
const body = pm.response.json();

const schema = { type:'object', required:['firstname','lastname','totalprice','depositpaid','bookingdates'], properties:{ firstname:{type:'string'}, lastname:{type:'string'}, totalprice:{type:'number'}, depositpaid:{type:'boolean'}, bookingdates:{type:'object', required:['checkin','checkout'], properties:{checkin:{type:'string'}, checkout:{type:'string'}}}, additionalneeds:{type:'string'} } };
pm.test('New booking detail returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Booking detail satisfies JSON Schema', function () { pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema(schema); });

pm.test('Booking detail matches runtime identity', function () { pm.expect(body.firstname).to.equal(pm.environment.get('runtimeFirstName')); pm.expect(body.lastname).to.equal(pm.environment.get('runtimeLastName')); });

pm.test('Booking detail matches submitted values', function () { pm.expect(body.totalprice).to.equal(111); pm.expect(body.depositpaid).to.equal(true); pm.expect(body.bookingdates.checkout).to.equal('2026-09-05'); pm.expect(body.additionalneeds).to.equal('Breakfast'); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Authenticated PUT returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('PUT replaces identity fields', function () { pm.expect(body.firstname).to.equal('Updated-' + pm.environment.get('runtimeFirstName')); pm.expect(body.lastname).to.equal('Updated-' + pm.environment.get('runtimeLastName')); });
pm.test('PUT replaces scalar fields', function () { pm.expect(body.totalprice).to.equal(222); pm.expect(body.depositpaid).to.equal(false); pm.expect(body.additionalneeds).to.equal('Dinner'); });
pm.test('PUT replaces complete booking dates', function () { pm.expect(body.bookingdates).to.deep.equal({checkin:'2026-10-01', checkout:'2026-10-07'}); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('GET after PUT returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('PUT identity persisted', function () { pm.expect(body.firstname).to.equal('Updated-' + pm.environment.get('runtimeFirstName')); pm.expect(body.lastname).to.equal('Updated-' + pm.environment.get('runtimeLastName')); });
pm.test('PUT scalar fields persisted', function () { pm.expect(body.totalprice).to.equal(222); pm.expect(body.depositpaid).to.equal(false); pm.expect(body.additionalneeds).to.equal('Dinner'); });
pm.test('PUT dates persisted', function () { pm.expect(body.bookingdates).to.deep.equal({checkin:'2026-10-01', checkout:'2026-10-07'}); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Authenticated PATCH returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('PATCH changes selected fields', function () { pm.expect(body.firstname).to.equal('Patched-' + pm.environment.get('runtimeFirstName')); pm.expect(body.additionalneeds).to.equal('Late checkout'); });

pm.test('PATCH preserves untouched identity and price', function () { pm.expect(body.lastname).to.equal('Updated-' + pm.environment.get('runtimeLastName')); pm.expect(body.totalprice).to.equal(222); });

pm.test('PATCH preserves untouched boolean and dates', function () { pm.expect(body.depositpaid).to.equal(false); pm.expect(body.bookingdates).to.deep.equal({checkin:'2026-10-01', checkout:'2026-10-07'}); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('GET after PATCH returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('PATCH changes persisted', function () { pm.expect(body.firstname).to.equal('Patched-' + pm.environment.get('runtimeFirstName')); pm.expect(body.additionalneeds).to.equal('Late checkout'); });

pm.test('Untouched PATCH identity and price persisted', function () { pm.expect(body.lastname).to.equal('Updated-' + pm.environment.get('runtimeLastName')); pm.expect(body.totalprice).to.equal(222); });

pm.test('Untouched PATCH boolean and dates persisted', function () { pm.expect(body.depositpaid).to.equal(false); pm.expect(body.bookingdates).to.deep.equal({checkin:'2026-10-01', checkout:'2026-10-07'}); });
pm.test('PATCH without authentication is rejected with observed 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Booking still exists after rejected PATCH', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Rejected PATCH did not change protected price', function () { pm.expect(body.totalprice).to.equal(222); });

pm.test('Rejected PATCH preserved prior partial-update state', function () { pm.expect(body.firstname).to.equal('Patched-' + pm.environment.get('runtimeFirstName')); pm.expect(body.additionalneeds).to.equal('Late checkout'); });
pm.test('DELETE with invalid token is rejected with observed 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Booking still exists after rejected DELETE', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Rejected DELETE preserved runtime booking identity', function () { pm.expect(body.firstname).to.equal('Patched-' + pm.environment.get('runtimeFirstName')); pm.expect(body.lastname).to.equal('Updated-' + pm.environment.get('runtimeLastName')); });
pm.test('Rejected DELETE preserved runtime booking data', function () { pm.expect(body.totalprice).to.equal(222); pm.expect(body.additionalneeds).to.equal('Late checkout'); });

item.name: 04 Negative / Contract
item.description: Observed negative behavior only; 500 and 418 are not presented as defects or normative contract requirements.

exec: pm.test('Unknown booking ID returns observed 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });

item.name: Create booking with missing payload - observed behavior

request.description: API-NEG-003 observed negative behavior; not a defect claim

exec: pm.test('Missing create payload returns observed 500', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(500); });

request.description: API-NEG-004 observed negative behavior; not a defect claim

exec: pm.test('Unsupported Accept handling matches a known observed outcome', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 418]); });

item.name: 99 Cleanup
item.description: Deletes only bookingId captured from the current run.

request.description: Authenticated, targeted teardown of only the current run resource

exec: pm.test('Authenticated cleanup deletes runtime booking with documented 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('GET after cleanup returns observed 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.environment.unset('bookingId');
pm.environment.unset('token');
